# Meeting Info
- Time/Date: Sept 3rd @ 2pm UTC
- [sign up for calendar invite here](https://forms.gle/Rm4zF38Zs6BrVYRS7)
- Zoom: shared in the "L2 interop working group" telegram prior to the call 
- Recording: tbd

# Agenda
- Recap and Q&A of the "[Protocol Update 003 - Improve UX](https://blog.ethereum.org/2025/08/29/protocol-update-003)" blog post
- [ERC-3643](https://www.erc3643.org/) - RWA tokenization [Dennis] 
- [ERC-7828,](https://eip.tools/eip/7828) [L2 resolver spec](https://github.com/ethereum/L2-interop/pull/44), and [ERC-7785](https://eip.tools/eip/7785) [Wonderland and Unruggable]
- Axal - 7702 paymasters, transaction batching and gas sponsorship 
- [ERC-7806](https://erc7806.io/) - intent-centric EOA smart account [Han] 

_have something for the agenda? add comment below or DM @rudolf6 on TG_
